headline: Australia sets a national foundation for AI assurance across government
summary: Australia’s Department of Finance published a national foundation for assurance of AI use across Australian, state and territory governments. The framework spans development, procurement and deployment and describes risk-based, lifecycle practices, including governance, testing and ongoing monitoring. It leaves detailed policies to each jurisdiction and says practices should reflect local law and operational context; publication alone does not establish binding force, adoption or outcomes. A 2026–2028 NSW strategy separately says state agencies will comply with NSW’s AI Assurance Framework, an example of jurisdiction-specific commitment rather than a national mandate.
